name: inspeck-claude
description: Inspeck: hover any element to see its CSS, click to leave a note for Claude.

scripts.build:listen: mkdir -p server/bin && swiftc -O -swift-version 5 -target arm64-apple-macos26.0 -Xlinker -sectcreate -Xlinker __TEXT -Xlinker __info_plist -Xlinker native/listen/Info.plist native/listen/main.swift -o /tmp/inspeck-listen-arm64 && swiftc -O -swift-version 5 -target x86_64-apple-macos26.0 -Xlinker -sectcreate -Xlinker __TEXT -Xlinker __info_plist -Xlinker native/listen/Info.plist native/listen/main.swift -o /tmp/inspeck-listen-x86_64 && lipo -create /tmp/inspeck-listen-arm64 /tmp/inspeck-listen-x86_64 -output server/bin/inspeck-listen && codesign --force --sign - --identifier dev.inspeck.listen server/bin/inspeck-listen && rm /tmp/inspeck-listen-arm64 /tmp/inspeck-listen-x86_64
